changes: Prospective job validated exactly against the existing diagnostic design; no changes to the frozen offline draft.
Initial visible definition and revisions preserved from original raw native response text, with append-only event links and timestamps.
Raw response journaled before parsing. Malformed output, reused IDs and horizon violations stop without automatic retry.
Each action links to its latest genuinely earlier definition. Revisions never relabel earlier actions. Definitions after any tool observation marked post_result.
Ordinary workflow has no elicited definition and no inferred definition from SQL.
Definition protocols reconstruct a new action context after the first response; this intervention is explicit, not claimed to be one uninterrupted model conversation.
Revisions consume existing action-generation slots, not extra tool attempts. Four-action-generation horizon preserved.

limitations: Logical requests are not provider-ready payloads. No transport, tokenizer or billing parity is established for the new definition tools.
Caller must authenticate public source inputs and observations and seal the journal. This state machine alone is not an execution authority or a provenance attestation.
No semantic grading, causal inference or automatic A/B/C label is performed.
Definition elicitation and revision affordances can change behavior; comparisons with ordinary workflow are protocol comparisons, not passive measurements.
